# Sameer Ul Haque (uxbysameer)

> AI-Native Product Designer based in Bengaluru, India, who designs AI products and builds the agents and automations that run them. 14+ years designing and shipping products, 105+ products shipped. The full portfolio at uxbysameer.com is being rebuilt and launching soon.

- Brands: Lenovo, Decathlon, Mashreq Bank, TCS, Infosys, EasyWebinar, Cashel Family, Catalyse Digital, Cybonet
- MIT-certified in AI and ML
- Top 1% mentor on ADPList, multiple times; has taught and mentored 650+ designers worldwide
- Open to full-time roles (remote worldwide or relocation), client projects and teaching
